messages.subject: error running MSstats from Skyline
parts:
Hi- I am getting the following error when I run MS stats group comparison from within Skyline.

" ** Data Processing for analysis..... 
Error in dataProcess(raw, normalization = inputnormalize, nameStandards = standardpepname,  : 
  Statistical tools in MSstats are only proper for label-free or with reference peptide experiments.

 Error : Can't process the data.  "

I have just upgraded to the newest version and R scripts, but the error persists. I think I have all the necessary columns added to the Skyline results grid and filled out. These are MRM data measuring light peptide with heavy internal standard peptide. I am unsure where, but I must have overlooked a setting or annotation.  The setup in the 3.6 manual shows numerous other columns, like precursor and product charge, isotope type, etc. are these all necessary? and could you recommend other settings I may have overlooked?

thanks,

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: error running MSstats from Skyline
parts:
What I can guess from error message is that 'Label' information (endogeneous vs heavy peptide) seems not correct. But, not sure whether you need to change any setting in Skyline or MSstats problem. Could you share MSstats input  csv file from Skyline? You can get this file, Skyline > File > Export > select 'MSstats input' > select the location where you want to save. Then 'MSstats input.csv' file will be generated. You can send it to me directly. I will keep it confidentially and remove it after checking.

Thanks,

- Meena
